current.text: Portland's projected starters are Scoot Henderson, Damian Lillard, Toumani Camara, Deni Avdija and Donovan Clingan. Only the fifth spot, his spot, is uncertain.
The expert has low confidence that he holds the starting job. Jrue Holiday or Henderson should start most nights, and he could lose the spot early to Holiday or Ja Morant.
He is a late-round swing, not a must-draft.
Portland's backcourt is crowded. Lillard is back, Holiday and Morant were added, and Avdija also handles the ball, so playmaking and usage are shared.
Portland has a new, first-time head coach. He may mix up the lineup, and minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game.
He missed most of last season, and Portland expects to have him for a full season this year.
Only 47.3% of his potential assists turned into actual assists.
The expert links his low assist conversion to poor finishing by teammates such as Clingan and Camara.
Portland plays 10 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, with three back-to-backs in the playoffs. The team has 15 back-to-backs this season.
Portland's playoff schedule is weak for a season that ends March 28.
